step_therapy_requirements: Trial and failure of ≥ 3 months of at least one (1) conventional systemic therapy (methotrexate, cyclosporin, acitretin) or phototherapy (psoralen plus ultraviolet A light), unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are experienced.
reauth_requirements: Member is currently receiving medication in the past 120 days that has been authorized by RxAdvance or the member has met initial approval criteria.
reasoning: TREMFYA is approved for patients with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who have tried and failed at least one conventional systemic therapy or phototherapy.
